mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_NOTICE_REPORT ( TITLE, TO_USER, DIVISION, SHOP_TYPE, SHOP_ID, INPUT_DATE, TO_USER_NO ) VALUES ( #{TITLE}, #{TO_USER}, #{DIVISION}, #{SHOP_TYPE}, #{SHOP_ID}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{USER_NO} )

INSERT INTO CBCI_ACCESS_RECORD ( DIVISION, USER_ID, USER_NAME, IP_ADDRESS, ACCESS_URI, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{DIVISION}, #{USER_ID}, #{USER_NAME}, #{IP_ADDRESS}, #{ACCESS_URI}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_USER WHERE FIRM_ID = #{FIRM_ID}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_PARTNER WHERE partner_id = #{FIRM_ID}
SELECT TYPE_NO, -- 타입번호 TYPE_NAME -- 타입명 FROM CBCI_BIZTYPE ORDER BY TYPE_NO ASC
SELECT SEC_NO, -- 업종 ID SEC_NAME -- 업종 이름 FROM CBCI_SECTOR ORDER BY SEC_NO ASC
SELECT CAST(CODE_ID AS UNSIGNED) AS CODE_ID, -- 코드 ID CODE_NM -- 코드명 FROM CBCI_CODE WHERE META_ID = 'SHOP_TYPE' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CODE_NM ASC
SELECT partner_code AS FIRM_NO, -- 협력사 코드 partner_nm AS FIRM_NM -- 협력사명 FROM CBCI_PARTNER ORDER BY partner_code ASC

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(LINKED_NO SEPARATOR ',') AS CODE_LIST, CONCAT('^', GROUP_CONCAT(FIRM_NM SEPARATOR '|^')) AS FIRM_LIST FROM( SELECT LINKED_NO, FIRM_NM FROM CBCI_LINKED_CODE WHERE LINKED_STATUS='운영' AND LINKED_CODE = '0' ) B2B_TB
SELECT SELECT_CD, SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CLASS = #{SELECT_CLASS} ORDER BY LENGTH (SELECT_NM) DESC
SELECT user_type, user_pw FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_CODE = #{value}
SELECT auth_role FROM CBCI_AUTH WHERE auth_division = 'user' AND auth_type = #{value}
SELECT auth_type ,auth_name FROM CBCI_AUTH WHERE auth_type NOT IN ('00', #{except_type}) AND auth_division = 'user'
SELECT charge_code ,charge_name FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc ORDER BY cbc.sub_unit desc, charge_code desc

SELECT cc.code_e_nm, IF(ca.shop_id, 'false', 'true') as isShop FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT ca LEFT JOIN CBCI_CODE cc ON cc.code_id = ca.shop_type WHERE ca.SHOP_TYPE IN ('4', '11', '14') AND ca.user_code = #{userCode} GROUP BY ca.SHOP_TYPE

SELECT CONCAT("SHOP_", ca.shop_type) as shop_type, GROUP_CONCAT(IF(cu.user_code = #{value}, ca.shop_id, NULL) separator "' , '") as shop_id FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT ca LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON ca.user_code = cu.user_code GROUP BY ca.shop_type

SELECT IF(COUNT(cbpd.user_code) = 1, 'freePeriodEnd', 0) as modalId , DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.expire_date, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') as expire_date FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON cbpd.user_code = cu.USER_CODE WHERE cbpd.status LIKE 'U%' AND cbpd.USER_CODE = #{user_code} AND cu.USER_TYPE = '01' AND cbpd.charge_code IN (SELECT charge_code FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE charge_type ='F') AND NOW() >= DATE_SUB(cbpd.expire_date, INTERVAL 5 DAY) AND NOW() <= DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT IF(COUNT(cbpd.user_code) = 1, 'periodEnd', 0) as modalId , cbc.charge_name , DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.start_date, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') as start_date , DATE_FORMAT(cbpd.expire_date, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') as expire_date FROM CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL cbpd LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE cbc ON cbpd.charge_code = cbc.charge_code LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON cbpd.user_code = cu.USER_CODE WHERE cbpd.status LIKE 'U%' AND cbpd.USER_CODE = #{user_code} AND cu.USER_TYPE = '01' AND cbpd.charge_code NOT IN (SELECT charge_code FROM CBCI_BILLING_CHARGE WHERE charge_type = 'F') AND cbpd.expire_date = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT IF(COUNT(cu.USER_CODE) = 1, 'MbPeriodEnd', 0) as modalId , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_date, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') as contract_date , DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') as contract_expire_date FROM MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur LEFT JOIN CBCI_USER cu ON mur.user_code = cu.USER_CODE WHERE cu.USER_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND cu.USER_CODE = #{user_code} AND ((NOW() >= DATE_SUB(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND NOW() <= DATE_FORMAT(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) OR (NOW() >= DATE_SUB(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND NOW() <= DATE_ADD((DATE_SUB(mur.mb_contract_expire_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)), INTERVAL 3 DAY)))
SELECT USER_PHONE FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_CODE = #{USER_CODE}

SELECT IF(COUNT(USER_CODE) >= 1, 'Y', 'N') as mb_check_success FROM CBCI_USER WHERE USER_CODE = #{user_code} AND #{mb_business_period} <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND #{mb_business_type} NOT IN ('13') AND #{mb_individual} IN ('1') AND #{mb_sales_amount} >= 10000000 AND #{mb_user_age} >= 20 AND #{mb_duplicate_check} = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MONEYBANK_ADVANCE_REQUEST_CHECK( user_code , mb_business_period , mb_business_type , mb_individual , mb_sales_amount , mb_user_age , mb_duplicate_check , mb_check_success , input_date )VALUES( #{user_code} , IF(#{mb_business_period} <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR), 'Y', 'N') , IF(#{mb_business_type} NOT IN ('13'), 'Y', 'N') , IF(#{mb_individual} IN ('1'), 'Y', 'N') , IF(#{mb_sales_amount} >= 10000000, 'Y', 'N') , IF(#{mb_user_age} >= 20, 'Y', 'N') , #{mb_duplicate_check} , #{mb_check_success} , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT bank_code, bank_name FROM CBCI_BANK_CODE
SELECT IF(COUNT(*) = 0, "true", "false") as result FROM CBCI_HOLIDAY CH WHERE DAY_OF_THE_WEEK IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05') AND HOLIDAY_DATE = #{dateStr}
